displayName: OCI-AI-GOV-020: AI — Monitoring and Logging Gap
description:
Detects gaps in AI system monitoring and logging required by governance frameworks

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_gov_020", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%monitoring%' AND "value" > 0
